name: Agent approvals
author: dsskaggs
description: Flashing bar light whenever any AI agent on this machine is waiting on a human approval — Hermes (Telegram/Buzz/CLI), Claude Code, Codex, herdr/tmux agents.

barWidget.description: Dim when nothing is pending. Flashes red with a count when one or more agents are blocked waiting for you. Left-click: jump to the oldest pending agent. Right-click: clear all.
